task: Probe source-free import when a re-sealed arithmetic summary remains but its checked body is omitted.
observation: A canonically re-sealed staged interface with compute's checked-body record removed and an alternate legacy generic_stmt inserted still compiled and executed the legacy expression, returning 31. The normal C2c provider artifact has no generic_stmt for compute and executes the checked body as expected.
impact: The importer does not fail closed when a checked body is absent but a legacy statement is available, so artifact consumers can execute a body different from the retained summary's intended checked body.

resolution.summary: Reported as a separate fail-closed blocker per C2c scope; no importer redesign was made.
